source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: The dev tools' tsconfig bases, which the root tsconfig and every package extend, are inputs too.

superlint.description: The dev tools' rules and the repository's config are inputs too.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin and the repository's config are inputs too.

test.description: Every test that uses no network. Each run draws fresh rotating seeds, so a test never replays from cache; the run's seed, a replay and a fuzz run come through the environment.

//#dedupe.description: The lockfile is already deduplicated: pnpm dedupe would change nothing.
